server: PSF Guard 0.12.0 debug server built from the Rust source at 46e5645f8c7b14f9b4da1b742a481b75d3181417; fresh frontend from source_commit served via --static-dir.
reshoot: npm ci; npm run build in static. Use scripts/e2e-local.mjs e2e/whats-new.spec.ts with PSF_GUARD_E2E_BINARY pointing to a wrapper that calls a 0.12.0 server with --static-dir set to this worktree static/dist. Runner isolates registry and cache. It captures mobile before resizing to desktop.
previous_captures: captures.json and captures-plain-copy.json record the earlier wording; those images remain unchanged.
